mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
